posts.author: Ynotdat
posts.body:
It's been over a decade since I've used a forum properly, and since I just recently got into RPG Maker, I figured this forum would be the most helpful resource at my disposal. Wanted to give a quick introduction as I peruse the various guides and resources on here, and I hope to find my spot in this community as I learn and develop games!
I'm Ynotdat, some call me Ynot, and I'm 24. I'm a classically trained musician and composer, and as my creative interests grow, I find myself wanting to make games. I've already got some fundamentals of the engine down, although I've only spent 4-5 hours or so just following Venthros' guides and toying around with the various tools a bit, so I've far from fully grasped the tools in front of me yet.
My current long term goal is to make a full length RPG Maker game based on an existing piece of fiction, although I'm not sure what that piece of fiction would be yet, and my goals past that are to eventually start making wholly original games filled with my own spritework and musical compositions!
Thank you for reading this far! Have a wonderful rest of your week!
